item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows an object in front of a plane mirror and the image the mirror forms for Aarav.

Which claims about the image are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.A: The image is upright and the same size as the object.
options.B: The image appears behind the mirror and cannot be obtained on a screen.
options.C: The image is smaller than the object.
options.D: Every mirror forms an upright image the same size as the object.
